functionalRequirement: The system shall allow staff members to develop staff reports for publication and distribution.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide a comprehensive set of features for staff members to create, edit, and publish reports, including support for various report formats (e.g., PDF, DOCX) and distribution channels (e.g., email, print).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to support the development and distribution of staff reports, necessitating a complete set of features for report creation and dissemination.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that reports generated by staff members are accurate and consistent, with proper formatting and data validation, for 99.9% of report generations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for accurate and reliable report generation, which is critical for decision-making and communication.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The system must provide an intuitive and user-friendly interface for staff members to develop and publish reports, with clear and concise instructions and minimal cognitive load.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires staff members to interact with the system to create reports, which should be easy to use and understand.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must be able to recover from errors or exceptions during report generation and distribution, with minimal impact on system availability and user experience.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes that the system will be used to generate and distribute reports, which requires robustness and fault tolerance to ensure continuous operation.

functionalRequirement: User shall be guided to a login page after successfully registering, where they can enter their credentials to access the application.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide a seamless registration and login process, with automatic redirection to the login page after successful registration, for 100% of registration attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to guide users through the registration and login process, necessitating a complete and automated workflow.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must redirect users to the login page within 2 seconds after successful registration, for up to 100 concurrent registration attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves a real-time registration and login process, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide clear and concise instructions and feedback during the registration and login process, with minimal cognitive load and easy-to-understand error messages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to interact with the system to register and log in, which should be easy to learn and use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must verify user credentials during the login process, using a secure authentication protocol (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect), to ensure that only authorized users can access the application.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user authentication, which requires secure and reliable verification of user credentials to prevent unauthorized access.

functionalRequirement: System shall ensure that dataset instances of a type created during app deployment start using the new code when a new version of the dataset type is deployed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide a mechanism for automatically updating dataset instances to use the new code when a new version of the dataset type is deployed, with support for rollback and error handling.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to ensure that dataset instances are updated to use the new code, necessitating a complete and automated update mechanism.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 20% of available CPU resources to update dataset instances, to prevent performance degradation and ensure continuous operation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves updating dataset instances, which requires efficient resource utilization to prevent performance degradation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must be able to recover from errors or exceptions during the update process, with minimal impact on system availability and dataset integrity.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes that the system will be used to update dataset instances, which requires robustness and recoverability to ensure continuous operation and data integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must provide a flexible and modular architecture for updating dataset instances, with clear and well-documented APIs and interfaces, to facilitate future maintenance and updates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to be maintainable and adaptable to future changes, necessitating a flexible and modular architecture.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow site administrators to create news articles with designated publishing dates and expiry dates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide a comprehensive set of features for site administrators to create, edit, and publish news articles, including support for various article formats (e.g., text, images, videos) and scheduling options.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to support the creation and publication of news articles, necessitating a complete set of features for article creation and dissemination.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that news articles are published and expired according to their designated dates, with proper validation and error handling, for 99.9% of article publications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for accurate and reliable article publication and expiration, which is critical for content management and user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide an intuitive and user-friendly interface for site administrators to create and publish news articles, with clear and concise instructions and minimal cognitive load.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires site administrators to interact with the system to create and publish news articles, which should be easy to use and understand.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to site administrators to create and publish news articles, with minimal downtime and high uptime (e.g., 99.95%), to ensure continuous operation and content freshness.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes that the system will be used to create and publish news articles, which requires high availability and reliability to ensure continuous operation and content freshness.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide a comprehensive set of features for users to create a Gmail account, including support for various input formats (e.g., text, numbers) and validation rules.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to support the creation of a Gmail account, necessitating a complete set of features for account creation and validation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt user personal details (e.g., password, mobile number) using a secure encryption protocol (e.g., TLS, AES), to protect user data and prevent unauthorized access.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves the collection and storage of user personal details, which requires secure and reliable protection to prevent unauthorized access and data breaches.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide clear and concise instructions and feedback during the account creation process, with minimal cognitive load and easy-to-understand error messages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to interact with the system to create a Gmail account, which should be easy to learn and use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must create a Gmail account within 5 seconds after receiving the required user input, for up to 100 concurrent account creation attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves a real-time account creation process, requiring timely responses for usability.
